trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies. This is the platinum trophy awarded for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission "Gone Fishing". This is the first story mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in Chapter 1. Story progression trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in Chapter 2. Story progression trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in Chapter 3. Story progression trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in Chapter 4. Story progression trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is a gold trophy for finishing the main story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Breakfast Run". Part of the main story progression.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "The Cartel Heist". Part of the main story progression.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Child's Play". Part of the main story progression.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Headliners". Part of the main story progression.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "VCIA Takedown". Part of the main story progression.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Operation Savage Glory". Part of the main story progression.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Achieve 100% game completion. This requires completing all story missions, side missions, collectibles, activities, and challenges. This is the most time-consuming trophy.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 unique stunts across Leonida. Stunts include jumps, wheelies, stoppies, and other vehicle tricks. Can be done in any order throughout the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in all 9 activity types at least once. Activities include racing, drone racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, bowling, and more.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Achieve gold medal on all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each challenge to learn the patterns and timing required for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Each location has a unique drone race course.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events. Races can be street races, circuit races, or other race types found throughout Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing competition. This is a specific fishing challenge mission.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game cabinet found in the world. Arcade locations are marked on the map.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's entire stranger mission strand and finish his final mission. This is a stranger/freak mission line that can be missed if not started.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's entire stranger mission strand and finish his final mission. This is a stranger/freak mission line that can be missed if not started.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's entire stranger mission strand and finish his final mission. This is a stranger/freak mission line that can be missed if not started.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger/freak mission strands. These are side missions from NPCs marked with '?' on the map. Some strands have multiple missions. Track progress in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's entire stranger mission strand and finish his final mission. This is a stranger/freak mission line that can be missed if not started.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's entire stranger mission strand and finish his final mission. This is a stranger/freak mission line that can be missed if not started.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are marked on the map once discovered. No time limit.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting mission strand. This involves tracking and hunting a unique animal. Part of the stranger missions.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect and complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are found throughout the world and can be traded with other players or NPCs.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations across Leonida. The app marks locations on your map once discovered.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 distinct challenges. Challenges include daily/weekly challenges, stunt challenges, combat challenges, and more.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While playing with your partner (co-op or story partner), attain a 4-star wanted level and successfully escape. Can be done during free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 stores consecutively without the wanted level dropping. Requires coordination and fast getaways.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find and enter 100 unique vehicle models. Vehicle discovery is tracked in the pause menu under Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (slow-mo ability) and eliminate 5 enemies before it ends. Best done during combat-heavy missions or free roam shootouts.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Escape from the VCIA (Vice City Intelligence Agency) facility in an unconventional way. This is likely part of a specific mission.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks during a mission or free roam. Likely involves destroying or stealing a tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete a jewelry store heist using stealth. Avoid cameras, guards, and alarms. Can be attempted multiple times.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully rob 5 different bank vaults and escape with the loot. Bank heists are available in free roam and some missions.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hijack and rob an armored truck, then escape with the money. Armored trucks spawn randomly on roads.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Discover all 52 named areas/regions of Leonida. Exploration is tracked in the pause menu. Drive, fly, and sail to uncover the entire map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation (drug lab, counterfeit ring, etc.) for each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit a bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail. This is a simple interaction trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle through a showroom window/wall. Showrooms are found in urban areas.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley location. Complete at least one frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Achieve a high-scoring partnership moment in co-op or during a specific story beat with your partner.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make significant story choices throughout the game. PSN tracks a count to 500 choices made.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail a mission or objective, then succeed on the retry. Natural progression through difficult missions.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange/unexplained event in the game world. Could be a random encounter, Easter egg, or story moment.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a pedestrian with a melee attack while driving by (drive-by melee). Requires a vehicle and melee weapon.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Accumulate $250,000 from laundering marked bills through your criminal contacts. This is a money-making activity tracked over time.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 at shops (clothing, weapons, vehicles, food, etc.). Tracked across the entire playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 available garage properties. Garages provide vehicle storage and are marked on the map.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (vehicle sharing/rental service). Access the app on your in-game phone.
